body:
LEAD DISPOSITION: ACCEPT all four amendments.

B0 closure will be outcome-sensitive: a Hold or ADRReplacementRequired record is valid evidence of unresolved state but cannot close the required Sherlock path. Closure requires an admitted exact artifact/use or an actually ratified ADR replacement that names the substitute and revises/skips D0.

AdmitFor(use) will be factorized into artifact identity, rights evidence, access basis, owner risk decision, permitted and forbidden actions, expiry/recheck, and reviewer. No permission inherits across component, corpus, film, subtitle, participant, or provider leaves.

B0-D will freeze only a disclosure schema and externally executable validation protocol. D0 remains the first source-bearing repository reader. Receipts will use a fixed nonsemantic allowlist, enumerated outcomes including NotRun(RightsHold), mosaic-leak review, no raw logs/free text/paths/data-derived labels, and a separate rights-decision reference. A Passed receipt proves only repair conformance.

The synthetic oracle will use deliberately non-Sherlock coordinates/cardinalities and explicit Synthetic provenance. I also accept the live-state correction: cand-7MEX now has authorization_absent plus git_evidence_stale, so the pinned summary must no longer call authorization its sole blocker.

These amendments will be incorporated into the replacement B0 decision after the remaining named board reviewers respond.
